title: Seal
direction: A maker's mark pressed by hand into good paper: a hand-cut terracotta chop with a carved k, and a letterpress-tooled humanist lowercase word.
rationale: Every identity begins with a mark of the maker; Markilo's own is a carved seal, warm and exact, the opposite of the category's bright, flat generator look.
semantics: maker's mark; pressed seal; carved negative space; the k of markilo; hand and precision

pitch.idea: One knife angle makes the whole identity: a terracotta block whose top is cut at it, a k carved out standing on the block's edge, and every stem of the word cut top and foot at the same angle, with the i dotted by the block itself.
strengths: Warm, hand-tooled and clearly not a generator logo: nothing in the category looks pressed or carved
One consistent cut angle ties seal, word and i-dot into a single system that also works in one colour
The seal survives at 16 px as a distinctive slanted silhouette
weaknesses: The icon is still a letter in a shape: the k carries the name but not a product truth, and could be read as a generic k app icon
The chisel cuts on the word are quiet below ~40 px, where it reads as plain Alegreya Sans
The tilted top can read as a flag or a price tag at a glance
